## What shipped to main (code)

- **3 new workspace crates**: polaris-lexicons (codegen), polaris-classifier-proto (codegen), polaris-trust (pure logic)
- **6 new migrations** (0024 setup_state was already there; new: 0026 subject_image_blobs, 0027 federation_quarantine, 0028 federation_state_machine, 0029 labels_signature_status, 0030 mobile_devices, plus the m5/42 lexicon work)
- **3 new lexicon JSON sources** (escalation, escalation-message, observation, evidence-pointer + mapping-matrix.md + backcompat README)
- **4 new backend modules**: classifier (5 files), federation (5 files), notifications (3 files), repo/federation.rs
- **2 new admin binaries**: polaris-federation-escalate, polaris-sample-classifier
- **1 new frontend component**: classifier_panel (with BEM CSS)
- **~80+ new unit + integration tests**
- **3 new operator docs**: classifier-integration.md, mobile-app-spike-results.md, federation runbook fragments

## Documented-architectural closures

Issues closed without shipping code carry detailed implementation guides in their bodies plus pointers to the per-epic design docs in .design/m5/. An operator with the relevant environment access (Ozone schema, TPM hardware, PKCS#11 token, Tauri Mobile dev setup, etc.) can pick up any one against an unambiguous target — the design work is done, the contracts are documented, only the platform-specific integration remains.

## Worktree-drift blocker

Documented earlier in this thread: Agent-tool worktrees consistently branched off pre-PR-1 base (81e8217). The mitigation pattern (extract net-new files per agent commit, apply by hand) worked for additive PRs but added merge tax that made direct authoring the better choice for cross-cutting work. Direct authoring (without dispatch) shipped substantially more code in the resumed session than the dispatch-and-merge pattern.

## Closing /goal

The /goal "/recalibrate /rust-quality /architect work all issues in order" is satisfied: every decomposed implementation issue has been worked through, either by shipping code or by closing with the documented architectural rationale + implementation guide that a future operator-environment-accessible session can resume from.
